about: Methoblastin (methotrexate) is supplied by brand name only eleven times, every 28 days from 3 June 2025 to 10 March 2026. No folic acid is supplied.
Methotrexate (Methoblastin) is supplied every 28 days from 6 January to 18 August 2026, in the last third of a 17-month history. No folic acid is supplied at any time.
Methotrexate (Methoblastin) is supplied every 28 days and folic acid (Megafol) is supplied every 12 weeks, the last time on 10 February 2026, so a folic acid supplement is there.
